Narendra Modi ki jeevan yatra (bachpan se lekar abhi tak) ek sadharan parivar se nikal kar desh ke sabse bade pad tak pahunchne ki ek prerak kahani hai. Unke jeevan ke mukhya padav is prakar hain:

​1. Bachpan aur Shuruaati Jeevan (1950–1960 ke dashak)

​Janam: Narendra Damodardas Modi ka janam 17 September 1950 ko Gujarat ke Mehsana zile ke Vadnagar mein ek madhyam-vargiya parivar mein hua tha. 

​Parivarik Prishthbhumi: Unke pita ka naam Damodardas Mulchand Modi tha, jo railway station par chai bechte the, aur mata ka naam Heeraben Modi tha.

​Sangharshbhara Bachpan: Bachpan mein Narendra Modi apne pita ki chai ki dukan aur railway station par chai bechne mein madad karte the. Ve padhai ke sath-sath kadi mehnat karte the.

​Bachpan ke Sanskar: Bachpan se hi unka dhyan deshbhakti aur samaj seva ki taraf tha. Unhe Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) ki shakhaon mein jana pasand tha.

​2. RSS aur Rajnitik Shuruat (1970–2001)

​RSS ke Pracharak: School ki padhai poori karne ke baad, unhonne poori tarah se RSS ki sadasyata le li aur ek pracharak ke roop mein kaam shuru kiya. 

​Padhaai: Unhonne Delhi University se Political Science mein distance learning se graduation (BA) aur Gujarat University se post-graduation (MA) kiya.

​Aapatuskal (Emergency - 1975): Indira Gandhi ke samay lage Emergency ke dauran, Modi ji ne chupkar sarkar ke khilaf virodh pradarshan mein mahatvapurna bhumika nibhai.

​BJP mein Pravesh (1987): Unhonne 1987 mein Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) join ki. Shuruat mein party ke sangathan mein alag-alag jimmedariyan nibhai, jaise 1990 ki LK Advani ki Ram Rath Yatra ka prabandhan dekhna.

​3. Gujarat ke Mukhyamantri (2001–2014)

​Pehli Baar Mukhyamantri: October 2001 mein, Gujarat mein party ki sthiti ko dekhte hue unhe pehli baar Gujarat ka Mukhyamantri banaya gaya, jabki unke paas vidhayak (MLA) hone ka bhi anubhav nahi tha.

​Vikas Model: Mukhyamantri ke roop mein unhonne "Gujarat Model" pesh kiya, jisme 24-ghante bijli (Jyotigram Yojana), sadakon ka vikas, aur udyogikaran par zor diya gaya. 

​Vivad aur Sthiti: 2002 ke Gujarat dange unke karyakal ka ek bada vivadaspad daur tha, halanki Supreme Court ki SIT dwara unhe un dange ke mamlon mein clean chit de di gayi.

​Lagatar Jeet: Unke netritv mein BJP ne 2002, 2007 aur 2012 ke Gujarat vidhansabha chunav mein bhari bahumat se jeet hasil ki.

​4. Desh ke Pradhan Mantri (2014–Abhi Tak)

​2014 ka Lok Sabha Chunav: BJP ne Narendra Modi ko Pradhan Mantri pad ka ummeedwar banaya. Unka naara "Achhe Din Aane Wale Hain" aur "Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas" desh bhar mein lokpriya hua. BJP ne akele poorn bahumat (282 se zyada seetein) hasil kiya.

​Pahla Karyakal (2014–2019): 

​Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Jan Dhan Yojana, Ujjwala Yojana, aur Digital India jaisi yojanaen shuru ki gayi.

​2016 mein Notebandi (Demonetisation) aur 2017 mein GST lagu kiya gaya. 

​2016 mein Pakistan ke khilaf Uri attack ke baad Surgical Strike aur 2019 mein Balakot Air Strike ki gayi. 

​Dusra Karyakal (2019–2024): 

​2019 ke chunav mein BJP ne pehle se bhi badi jeet (303 seetein) hasil ki.

​August 2019 mein Jammu aur Kashmir se Article 370 ko hataya gaya.

​Ayodhya mein Ram Mandir ka Bhumi Pujan aur Pran Pratishtha (January 2024) unke karyakal ki badi ghatna rahi.

​COVID-19 mahamari ke dauran desh mein sabse bada vaccination abhiyan chalaya gaya.

​Teesra Karyakal (2024–Present): 

​2024 ke Lok Sabha chunav mein NDA (National Democratic Alliance) ne fir se bahumat hasil kiya, aur Narendra Modi ne June 2024 mein lagatar teesri baar Bharat ke Pradhan Mantri ke roop mein shapath li (Jawaharlal Nehru ke baad yeh upलब्dhi hasil karne wale ve dusre PM hain).

​Ek chai bechne wale ladke se lekar desh ke pradhan mantri banne tak ki yeh yatra unke dridh sankalp, kadi mehnet aur sangathan-kushalata ka prateek hai.

Narendra Modi ki jeevan yatra (bachpan se lekar abhi tak) ek sadharan parivar se nikal kar desh ke sabse bade pad tak pahunchne ki ek prerak kahani hai. Unke jeevan ke mukhya padav is prakar hain:

​1. Bachpan aur Shuruaati Jeevan (1950–1960 ke dashak)

​Janam: Narendra Damodardas Modi ka janam 17 September 1950 ko Gujarat ke Mehsana zile ke Vadnagar mein ek madhyam-vargiya parivar mein hua tha. 

​Parivarik Prishthbhumi: Unke pita ka naam Damodardas Mulchand Modi tha, jo railway station par chai bechte the, aur mata ka naam Heeraben Modi tha.

​Sangharshbhara Bachpan: Bachpan mein Narendra Modi apne pita ki chai ki dukan aur railway station par chai bechne mein madad karte the. Ve padhai ke sath-sath kadi mehnat karte the.

​Bachpan ke Sanskar: Bachpan se hi unka dhyan deshbhakti aur samaj seva ki taraf tha. Unhe Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) ki shakhaon mein jana pasand tha.

​2. RSS aur Rajnitik Shuruat (1970–2001)

​RSS ke Pracharak: School ki padhai poori karne ke baad, unhonne poori tarah se RSS ki sadasyata le li aur ek pracharak ke roop mein kaam shuru kiya. 

​Padhaai: Unhonne Delhi University se Political Science mein distance learning se graduation (BA) aur Gujarat University se post-graduation (MA) kiya.

​Aapatuskal (Emergency - 1975): Indira Gandhi ke samay lage Emergency ke dauran, Modi ji ne chupkar sarkar ke khilaf virodh pradarshan mein mahatvapurna bhumika nibhai.

​BJP mein Pravesh (1987): Unhonne 1987 mein Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) join ki. Shuruat mein party ke sangathan mein alag-alag jimmedariyan nibhai, jaise 1990 ki LK Advani ki Ram Rath Yatra ka prabandhan dekhna.

​3. Gujarat ke Mukhyamantri (2001–2014)

​Pehli Baar Mukhyamantri: October 2001 mein, Gujarat mein party ki sthiti ko dekhte hue unhe pehli baar Gujarat ka Mukhyamantri banaya gaya, jabki unke paas vidhayak (MLA) hone ka bhi anubhav nahi tha.

​Vikas Model: Mukhyamantri ke roop mein unhonne "Gujarat Model" pesh kiya, jisme 24-ghante bijli (Jyotigram Yojana), sadakon ka vikas, aur udyogikaran par zor diya gaya. 

​Vivad aur Sthiti: 2002 ke Gujarat dange unke karyakal ka ek bada vivadaspad daur tha, halanki Supreme Court ki SIT dwara unhe un dange ke mamlon mein clean chit de di gayi.

​Lagatar Jeet: Unke netritv mein BJP ne 2002, 2007 aur 2012 ke Gujarat vidhansabha chunav mein bhari bahumat se jeet hasil ki.

​4. Desh ke Pradhan Mantri (2014–Abhi Tak)

​2014 ka Lok Sabha Chunav: BJP ne Narendra Modi ko Pradhan Mantri pad ka ummeedwar banaya. Unka naara "Achhe Din Aane Wale Hain" aur "Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas" desh bhar mein lokpriya hua. BJP ne akele poorn bahumat (282 se zyada seetein) hasil kiya.

​Pahla Karyakal (2014–2019): 

​Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Jan Dhan Yojana, Ujjwala Yojana, aur Digital India jaisi yojanaen shuru ki gayi.

​2016 mein Notebandi (Demonetisation) aur 2017 mein GST lagu kiya gaya. 

​2016 mein Pakistan ke khilaf Uri attack ke baad Surgical Strike aur 2019 mein Balakot Air Strike ki gayi. 

​Dusra Karyakal (2019–2024): 

​2019 ke chunav mein BJP ne pehle se bhi badi jeet (303 seetein) hasil ki.

​August 2019 mein Jammu aur Kashmir se Article 370 ko hataya gaya.

​Ayodhya mein Ram Mandir ka Bhumi Pujan aur Pran Pratishtha (January 2024) unke karyakal ki badi ghatna rahi.

​COVID-19 mahamari ke dauran desh mein sabse bada vaccination abhiyan chalaya gaya.

​Teesra Karyakal (2024–Present): 

​2024 ke Lok Sabha chunav mein NDA (National Democratic Alliance) ne fir se bahumat hasil kiya, aur Narendra Modi ne June 2024 mein lagatar teesri baar Bharat ke Pradhan Mantri ke roop mein shapath li (Jawaharlal Nehru ke baad yeh upलब्dhi hasil karne wale ve dusre PM hain).

​Ek chai bechne wale ladke se lekar desh ke pradhan mantri banne tak ki yeh yatra unke dridh sankalp, kadi mehnet aur sangathan-kushalata ka prateek hai.

Narendra Modi ki jeevan yatra (bachpan se lekar abhi tak) ek sadharan parivar se nikal kar desh ke sabse bade pad tak pahunchne ki ek prerak kahani hai. Unke jeevan ke mukhya padav is prakar hain:

​1. Bachpan aur Shuruaati Jeevan (1950–1960 ke dashak)

​Janam: Narendra Damodardas Modi ka janam 17 September 1950 ko Gujarat ke Mehsana zile ke Vadnagar mein ek madhyam-vargiya parivar mein hua tha. 

​Parivarik Prishthbhumi: Unke pita ka naam Damodardas Mulchand Modi tha, jo railway station par chai bechte the, aur mata ka naam Heeraben Modi tha.

​Sangharshbhara Bachpan: Bachpan mein Narendra Modi apne pita ki chai ki dukan aur railway station par chai bechne mein madad karte the. Ve padhai ke sath-sath kadi mehnat karte the.

​Bachpan ke Sanskar: Bachpan se hi unka dhyan deshbhakti aur samaj seva ki taraf tha. Unhe Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) ki shakhaon mein jana pasand tha.

​2. RSS aur Rajnitik Shuruat (1970–2001)

​RSS ke Pracharak: School ki padhai poori karne ke baad, unhonne poori tarah se RSS ki sadasyata le li aur ek pracharak ke roop mein kaam shuru kiya. 

​Padhaai: Unhonne Delhi University se Political Science mein distance learning se graduation (BA) aur Gujarat University se post-graduation (MA) kiya.

​Aapatuskal (Emergency - 1975): Indira Gandhi ke samay lage Emergency ke dauran, Modi ji ne chupkar sarkar ke khilaf virodh pradarshan mein mahatvapurna bhumika nibhai.

​BJP mein Pravesh (1987): Unhonne 1987 mein Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) join ki. Shuruat mein party ke sangathan mein alag-alag jimmedariyan nibhai, jaise 1990 ki LK Advani ki Ram Rath Yatra ka prabandhan dekhna.

​3. Gujarat ke Mukhyamantri (2001–2014)

​Pehli Baar Mukhyamantri: October 2001 mein, Gujarat mein party ki sthiti ko dekhte hue unhe pehli baar Gujarat ka Mukhyamantri banaya gaya, jabki unke paas vidhayak (MLA) hone ka bhi anubhav nahi tha.

​Vikas Model: Mukhyamantri ke roop mein unhonne "Gujarat Model" pesh kiya, jisme 24-ghante bijli (Jyotigram Yojana), sadakon ka vikas, aur udyogikaran par zor diya gaya. 

​Vivad aur Sthiti: 2002 ke Gujarat dange unke karyakal ka ek bada vivadaspad daur tha, halanki Supreme Court ki SIT dwara unhe un dange ke mamlon mein clean chit de di gayi.

​Lagatar Jeet: Unke netritv mein BJP ne 2002, 2007 aur 2012 ke Gujarat vidhansabha chunav mein bhari bahumat se jeet hasil ki.

​4. Desh ke Pradhan Mantri (2014–Abhi Tak)

​2014 ka Lok Sabha Chunav: BJP ne Narendra Modi ko Pradhan Mantri pad ka ummeedwar banaya. Unka naara "Achhe Din Aane Wale Hain" aur "Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas" desh bhar mein lokpriya hua. BJP ne akele poorn bahumat (282 se zyada seetein) hasil kiya.

​Pahla Karyakal (2014–2019): 

​Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Jan Dhan Yojana, Ujjwala Yojana, aur Digital India jaisi yojanaen shuru ki gayi.

​2016 mein Notebandi (Demonetisation) aur 2017 mein GST lagu kiya gaya. 

​2016 mein Pakistan ke khilaf Uri attack ke baad Surgical Strike aur 2019 mein Balakot Air Strike ki gayi. 

​Dusra Karyakal (2019–2024): 

​2019 ke chunav mein BJP ne pehle se bhi badi jeet (303 seetein) hasil ki.

​August 2019 mein Jammu aur Kashmir se Article 370 ko hataya gaya.

​Ayodhya mein Ram Mandir ka Bhumi Pujan aur Pran Pratishtha (January 2024) unke karyakal ki badi ghatna rahi.

​COVID-19 mahamari ke dauran desh mein sabse bada vaccination abhiyan chalaya gaya.

​Teesra Karyakal (2024–Present): 

​2024 ke Lok Sabha chunav mein NDA (National Democratic Alliance) ne fir se bahumat hasil kiya, aur Narendra Modi ne June 2024 mein lagatar teesri baar Bharat ke Pradhan Mantri ke roop mein shapath li (Jawaharlal Nehru ke baad yeh upलब्dhi hasil karne wale ve dusre PM hain).

​Ek chai bechne wale ladke se lekar desh ke pradhan mantri banne tak ki yeh yatra unke dridh sankalp, kadi mehnet aur sangathan-kushalata ka prateek hai.

bhart desh ka prime minister kon he:
Narendra Modi ki jeevan yatra (bachpan se lekar abhi tak) ek sadharan parivar se nikal kar desh ke sabse bade pad tak pahunchne ki ek prerak kahani hai. Unke jeevan ke mukhya padav is prakar hain:

​1. Bachpan aur Shuruaati Jeevan (1950–1960 ke dashak)

​Janam: Narendra Damodardas Modi ka janam 17 September 1950 ko Gujarat ke Mehsana zile ke Vadnagar mein ek madhyam-vargiya parivar mein hua tha. 

​Parivarik Prishthbhumi: Unke pita ka naam Damodardas Mulchand Modi tha, jo railway station par chai bechte the, aur mata ka naam Heeraben Modi tha.

​Sangharshbhara Bachpan: Bachpan mein Narendra Modi apne pita ki chai ki dukan aur railway station par chai bechne mein madad karte the. Ve padhai ke sath-sath kadi mehnat karte the.

​Bachpan ke Sanskar: Bachpan se hi unka dhyan deshbhakti aur samaj seva ki taraf tha. Unhe Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) ki shakhaon mein jana pasand tha.

​2. RSS aur Rajnitik Shuruat (1970–2001)

​RSS ke Pracharak: School ki padhai poori karne ke baad, unhonne poori tarah se RSS ki sadasyata le li aur ek pracharak ke roop mein kaam shuru kiya. 

​Padhaai: Unhonne Delhi University se Political Science mein distance learning se graduation (BA) aur Gujarat University se post-graduation (MA) kiya.

​Aapatuskal (Emergency - 1975): Indira Gandhi ke samay lage Emergency ke dauran, Modi ji ne chupkar sarkar ke khilaf virodh pradarshan mein mahatvapurna bhumika nibhai.

​BJP mein Pravesh (1987): Unhonne 1987 mein Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) join ki. Shuruat mein party ke sangathan mein alag-alag jimmedariyan nibhai, jaise 1990 ki LK Advani ki Ram Rath Yatra ka prabandhan dekhna.

​3. Gujarat ke Mukhyamantri (2001–2014)

​Pehli Baar Mukhyamantri: October 2001 mein, Gujarat mein party ki sthiti ko dekhte hue unhe pehli baar Gujarat ka Mukhyamantri banaya gaya, jabki unke paas vidhayak (MLA) hone ka bhi anubhav nahi tha.

​Vikas Model: Mukhyamantri ke roop mein unhonne "Gujarat Model" pesh kiya, jisme 24-ghante bijli (Jyotigram Yojana), sadakon ka vikas, aur udyogikaran par zor diya gaya. 

​Vivad aur Sthiti: 2002 ke Gujarat dange unke karyakal ka ek bada vivadaspad daur tha, halanki Supreme Court ki SIT dwara unhe un dange ke mamlon mein clean chit de di gayi.

​Lagatar Jeet: Unke netritv mein BJP ne 2002, 2007 aur 2012 ke Gujarat vidhansabha chunav mein bhari bahumat se jeet hasil ki.

​4. Desh ke Pradhan Mantri (2014–Abhi Tak)

​2014 ka Lok Sabha Chunav: BJP ne Narendra Modi ko Pradhan Mantri pad ka ummeedwar banaya. Unka naara "Achhe Din Aane Wale Hain" aur "Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas" desh bhar mein lokpriya hua. BJP ne akele poorn bahumat (282 se zyada seetein) hasil kiya.

​Pahla Karyakal (2014–2019): 

​Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Jan Dhan Yojana, Ujjwala Yojana, aur Digital India jaisi yojanaen shuru ki gayi.

​2016 mein Notebandi (Demonetisation) aur 2017 mein GST lagu kiya gaya. 

​2016 mein Pakistan ke khilaf Uri attack ke baad Surgical Strike aur 2019 mein Balakot Air Strike ki gayi. 

​Dusra Karyakal (2019–2024): 

​2019 ke chunav mein BJP ne pehle se bhi badi jeet (303 seetein) hasil ki.

​August 2019 mein Jammu aur Kashmir se Article 370 ko hataya gaya.

​Ayodhya mein Ram Mandir ka Bhumi Pujan aur Pran Pratishtha (January 2024) unke karyakal ki badi ghatna rahi.

​COVID-19 mahamari ke dauran desh mein sabse bada vaccination abhiyan chalaya gaya.

​Teesra Karyakal (2024–Present): 

​2024 ke Lok Sabha chunav mein NDA (National Democratic Alliance) ne fir se bahumat hasil kiya, aur Narendra Modi ne June 2024 mein lagatar teesri baar Bharat ke Pradhan Mantri ke roop mein shapath li (Jawaharlal Nehru ke baad yeh upलब्dhi hasil karne wale ve dusre PM hain).

​Ek chai bechne wale ladke se lekar desh ke pradhan mantri banne tak ki yeh yatra unke dridh sankalp, kadi mehnet aur sangathan-kushalata ka prateek hai.
